newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Trade slows slightly.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Trade slows slightly.

text.p: Cash bids for spring wheat were mostly marked up by one to two cents in response to modest gains in MGE futures, dealers said.
Trade had slowed down slightly after fairly active farmer selling earlier in the week, they added. Snow in Montana helped to restrict movement.

Dealers said recent farmer selling had been partly sparked by bearish sentiment about the price outlook. Pre-planting moisture levels appear excellent and at this stage there seems good reason to be optimistic about this year's crop prospects.
May MGE spring wheat futures closed one cent higher at $3.86-1/4 per bushel.
White wheat prices were mostly unchanged in quiet conditions.
"We've seen these prices before, so nobody is very excited," one white wheat trader said. "I think we will have to go to a new level to create any selling."
